description: This file implements a health check system for plugins in the Mattermost server, including scheduling, plugin health verification, restart, and deactivation logic.

classes.name: PluginHealthCheckJob
classes.description: A struct managing the scheduled health checks for plugins, including starting, stopping, and monitoring plugin health.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the continuous health check loop for active plugins, running at specified intervals.

methods.name: CheckPlugin
methods.description: Performs a health check on a specific plugin by ID, and handles failure by restarting or deactivating the plugin.

methods.name: getStoredTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of failure timestamps for a plugin.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Stops the health check job safely.
